instruction.text: Right now you're facing towards a closed door. Now turn behind, there is an open door to your right, move towards the door and turn right. There is a green color sofa to your right, move towards the sofa and slightly turn left. There is a small passage in front of you, move forward in the passage and stand at the entrance of the other room, where you can see a speaker and a television to your right and a portrait on the wall to your left and it is your end point.
